description: Piper neural TTS: synthesis latency from piper_server.py (span piper.synthesize, split by cache hit and voice) and the end-to-end request latency, errors and logs as seen by looma-TTS.php (span tts.piper).
title: Looma — TTS · Piper

panels.title: Requests ($__range)
panels.description: Piper requests made by looma-TTS.php (span tts.piper) in the selected time range.

targets.expr: sum(increase(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="looma-web",span_name="tts.piper", looma_device_name=~"$device", looma_geo_city=~"$city", looma_geo_country=~"$country"}[$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Errors ($__range)
panels.description: Piper synthesis calls that ended with span status STATUS_CODE_ERROR in the selected range.

targets.expr: sum(increase(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="looma-web",span_name="tts.piper", looma_device_name=~"$device", looma_geo_city=~"$city", looma_geo_country=~"$country",status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Error rate ($__range)
panels.description: Errored Piper calls as a percentage of all Piper calls in the selected range. Shows 0% when there is no traffic.

targets.expr: 100 * (sum(increase(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="looma-web",span_name="tts.piper", looma_device_name=~"$device", looma_geo_city=~"$city", looma_geo_country=~"$country",status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) / clamp_min(sum(increase(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="looma-web",span_name="tts.piper", looma_device_name=~"$device", looma_geo_city=~"$city", looma_geo_country=~"$country"}[$__range])) or vector(0), 1)

panels.title: End-to-end p50
panels.description: p50 of the full Piper request as seen by looma-TTS.php, over the $rate window. Measured on looma-TTS.php's tts.piper span, so it includes the HTTP hop to piper_server.py and the WAV transfer — compare with the Synthesis section for Piper's own time.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{service_name="looma-web",span_name="tts.piper", looma_device_name=~"$device", looma_geo_city=~"$city", looma_geo_country=~"$country"}[$rate])))

panels.title: End-to-end p95
panels.description: p95 of the full Piper request as seen by looma-TTS.php, over the $rate window. Measured on looma-TTS.php's tts.piper span, so it includes the HTTP hop to piper_server.py and the WAV transfer — compare with the Synthesis section for Piper's own time.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{service_name="looma-web",span_name="tts.piper", looma_device_name=~"$device", looma_geo_city=~"$city", looma_geo_country=~"$country"}[$rate])))

panels.title: End-to-end p99
panels.description: p99 of the full Piper request as seen by looma-TTS.php, over the $rate window. Measured on looma-TTS.php's tts.piper span, so it includes the HTTP hop to piper_server.py and the WAV transfer — compare with the Synthesis section for Piper's own time.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{service_name="looma-web",span_name="tts.piper", looma_device_name=~"$device", looma_geo_city=~"$city", looma_geo_country=~"$country"}[$rate])))

panels.title: Synthesis p50
panels.description: Median time piper_server.py spends producing the WAV (span piper.synthesize: cache lookup + Piper inference), over the $rate window. Includes cache hits — see the cache split below.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{span_name="piper.synthesize", looma_device_name=~"$device", looma_geo_city=~"$city", looma_geo_country=~"$country"}[$rate])))

panels.title: Synthesis p95
panels.description: 95th-percentile time piper_server.py spends producing the WAV (span piper.synthesize), over the $rate window.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{span_name="piper.synthesize", looma_device_name=~"$device", looma_geo_city=~"$city", looma_geo_country=~"$country"}[$rate])))

panels.title: Synthesis p99
panels.description: 99th-percentile time piper_server.py spends producing the WAV (span piper.synthesize), over the $rate window.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{span_name="piper.synthesize", looma_device_name=~"$device", looma_geo_city=~"$city", looma_geo_country=~"$country"}[$rate])))

panels.title: Uncached synthesis p95
panels.description: 95th-percentile synthesis time for cache misses only — the real cost of running the Piper model on new text. Needs the piper.cache_hit span-metrics dimension (otel-collector).

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{span_name="piper.synthesize", looma_device_name=~"$device", looma_geo_city=~"$city", looma_geo_country=~"$country", piper_cache_hit="false"}[$rate])))

panels.title: Cache hit ratio ($__range)
panels.description: Share of piper.synthesize calls answered from the WAV cache in the selected range.

targets.expr: 100 * (sum(increase(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{span_name="piper.synthesize", looma_device_name=~"$device", looma_geo_city=~"$city", looma_geo_country=~"$country", piper_cache_hit="true"}[$__range])) or vector(0)) / clamp_min(sum(increase(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{span_name="piper.synthesize", looma_device_name=~"$device", looma_geo_city=~"$city", looma_geo_country=~"$country"}[$__range])) or vector(0), 1)

panels.title: Proxy overhead p50
panels.description: Median end-to-end latency (tts.piper) minus median synthesis latency (piper.synthesize): time spent outside the Piper model — HTTP hop, Flask, WAV transfer. A rough estimate, since the difference of two percentiles is not the percentile of the difference.

targets.expr: clamp_min(histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{service_name="looma-web",span_name="tts.piper", looma_device_name=~"$device", looma_geo_city=~"$city", looma_geo_country=~"$country"}[$rate]))) - histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{span_name="piper.synthesize", looma_device_name=~"$device", looma_geo_city=~"$city", looma_geo_country=~"$country"}[$rate]))), 0)

panels.title: Synthesis latency p50 / p95 / p99
panels.description: Percentiles of piper.synthesize (Piper's own time to produce the WAV), over the $rate window.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{span_name="piper.synthesize", looma_device_name=~"$device", looma_geo_city=~"$city", looma_geo_country=~"$country"}[$rate])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{span_name="piper.synthesize", looma_device_name=~"$device", looma_geo_city=~"$city", looma_geo_country=~"$country"}[$rate])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{span_name="piper.synthesize", looma_device_name=~"$device", looma_geo_city=~"$city", looma_geo_country=~"$country"}[$rate])))

panels.title: Synthesis p95 — cache hit vs miss
panels.description: 95th-percentile synthesis time split by whether the WAV came from the cache (piper.cache_hit).

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, piper_cache_hit) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{span_name="piper.synthesize", looma_device_name=~"$device", looma_geo_city=~"$city", looma_geo_country=~"$country"}[$rate])))

panels.title: Synthesis p95 by voice
panels.description: 95th-percentile synthesis time per Piper voice model (piper.voice), cache misses only — shows which voices are slow to run.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, piper_voice) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{span_name="piper.synthesize", looma_device_name=~"$device", looma_geo_city=~"$city", looma_geo_country=~"$country", piper_cache_hit="false"}[$rate])))

panels.title: End-to-end vs synthesis (p95)
panels.description: looma-TTS.php's view of the request (tts.piper) next to Piper's own synthesis time (piper.synthesize). The gap is proxy/transfer overhead.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{service_name="looma-web",span_name="tts.piper", looma_device_name=~"$device", looma_geo_city=~"$city", looma_geo_country=~"$country"}[$rate])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{span_name="piper.synthesize", looma_device_name=~"$device", looma_geo_city=~"$city", looma_geo_country=~"$country"}[$rate])))

panels.title: Request rate
